megamenu.heading: Mega menu
megamenu.text: A full-width menu panel listing top-level sections with an optional icon, description and child links. The menu is hidden by default and toggled by any element with a data-js-mega-menu-trigger attribute matching the menu id. Clicking outside or pressing Escape closes it. Items marked active get the is-current class.

buttons.heading: Button-style items
buttons.text: Set parentType and/or childType to 'button' to render items as buttons. Style and color are controlled with parentStyle/parentStyleColor and childStyle/childStyleColor. Child buttons fall back to a chevron_right icon when no icon is set.

primary.heading: Colored background
primary.text: Add c-megamenu--primary or c-megamenu--secondary to the classList to use a colored background with contrasting link colors. c-megamenu--font-heading switches to the heading font.
